articles.title: OpenAI Gym Beta: g the public beta of OpenAI Gym, a toolkit for developing and comparing reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms
articles.desc: We’re releasing the public beta of OpenAI Gym, a toolkit for developing and comparing reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms. It consists of a growing suite of environments (from simulated robots to Atari games), and a site for comparing and reproducing results.
